title: Pattern Blue: two-stage TFT + Richards-curve dengue forecasting model for the 3rd Infodengue-Mosqlimate Dengue Challenge (IMDC 2026)
description:
Model submitted by team Pattern Blue (FGV EMAp) to the 3rd Infodengue-Mosqlimate Dengue Challenge (IMDC 2026), dengue tracks: state level (mandatory) and city level (optional).

Two-stage, parameter-based design: a single global Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) trained across all Brazilian municipalities predicts the parameters of the Richards curve fitted by the Episcanner pipeline to each epidemic season; the predicted parameters are then used to reconstruct the weekly incidence curve. State-level forecasts are the sum of the municipal curves. One model is trained per forecast cut-off.
